title: A new 15s teaser for my first real game - a top-down space sim. mini workflow in the post. lmk if you have questions or comments!
author: dankeHerrSkeltal
selftext:
been [working on my first real game](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5031310/Starscrip/) for about 6 weeks in godot & C#. 

general workflow for anything from marketing to in-game art assets and even music and audio is (but not text):  
  
prompt cloud-based genAI  (claude/ codex-- mostly sol 5.6 medium or high rn) to build tool -> monitor live & interrupt as needed if it drifts from my intent or I spot problems -> review tool's output with automated tests and my own eyes/ ears-> repeat. Limited direct output from genAI itself because procedural gen spares token usage and provide reproducibility.

the workflow for this social media focused teaser was basically that, and took a lot of iteration and automated research. I had 3 tracks for the music- an old ambient track, procedural percussion instruments to integrate, then I wanted to add a bass keyboard synth . 

And mix/master it, but then I didn't know the words to communicate what was wrong when it still felt off after like 22 iterations, so I had to have the bot look it up. And I found out, uh, something about materials, and voices, and all this stuff, something something, drum + synth keyboard not matching the ambient track. Took me like 25 iterations today to get this out..   
  
it's all I got for now. thanks for checkin it out, i gotta go chill. good luck with your dev
